title: deb. sends a love letter to FLINTA solidarity with “I Love You”
htmlContent:
Deb. brings a sparkling message of love and unity with their new single, "I Love You." This song celebrates the strength and spirit of FLINTA individuals, those who identify as women, lesbians, intersex, non-binary, trans, and agender, while drawing inspiration from the feminist movement.

"I Love You" radiates warmth and joy. The music is uplifting, and Deb.'s voice shines, spreading a message of support and celebration. A sense of community is woven throughout the song, a reminder that love can be a powerful force, especially when times are tough. This track blends serious themes with a sense of lightness. While it acknowledges the ongoing battle against gender inequality, it doesn't dwell on sadness.

https://open.spotify.com/track/56qb6THozABojMNSDQ5uHv?si=9kTtlC8bQVixMHresT_lhw

Deb. transforms that struggle into something uplifting, creating a song that highlights the beauty of standing side by side. "I Love You" is filled with joy and a strong message about the power of unity. Deb. shows that love, especially love that stands up against injustice, is one of our strongest tools for change.
